name: avatar
what: Roblox avatars from real catalog items (body package, hair, shirt, pants, face) as a rigged, animated studio tab, rendered by the studio
run: python3 catalog.py KIT --body ... --hair ... --shirt ... --pants ... --face ...; python3 avatar.py KIT OUT [--pose P] [--clip C] [--fx fx.json]; render: studio shots check with SHOTS_RENDER=1
prompt: Roblox avatar or character render: follow README Steps with the real catalog items (never guessed colours or shapes). Finished result: write OUT/studio to the studio tab via batches.json.
